description: Crop pages by setting the visible area (crop box). Trims margins or isolates a region. Coordinates are in points from bottom-left.

height.description: Height of crop area in points

pages.description: Pages to crop (1-indexed). Omit for all pages.

width.description: Width of crop area in points

x.description: Left edge of crop area (points from left)

y.description: Bottom edge of crop area (points from bottom)

name: pdf_crop
